recordType: Portable selected validation summary; not an original Archify receipt
classification: actual-run consumed-field projection from an original controlled fixture
upstreamExitMeaning: Intentional designed test failures, not hidden errors or successful tests

reader.executionPolicy: Existing reader consumes only projected reports and sidecars. No adapter input contract was modified for these measured records.
reader.artifactPolicy: Reader output is generated directly; no Markdown/JSON presentation postprocessing layer.

rawReceiptPolicy: Original Archify receipts/logs remain outside checkout; this summary selects stage results and artifact hashes without rewriting raw receipts.
